verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents its petition packages as its core service. The EB-1A/EB-1B/EB-2 NIW package is described as "fully managed from strategy to approval," and the all-inclusive packages cover government filing fees, premium processing and RFE/NOID responses, which implies the firm prepares and files the petition. The evidence never itemizes the specific deliverables the story names. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence-binder assembly, drafting of expert and support letters, and form preparation, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end execution.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: Our premium, white-glove package for the most complex employment-based petitions: EB-1A, EB-1B, and EB-2 NIW. Fully managed from strategy to approval.
All USCIS Government Filing Fees ... Premium Processing. ... Full Legal Defense For Any Potential RFE and NOID
We offer simple, all-inclusive packages that cover everything, including government filing fees, premium processing, and any RFE responses.
